Liverpool FC v Newcastle United

Premier League, Anfield, Saturday January 31, 8pm

Sale details

Members with a Premier League Home Credit Balance of 13 or more do not need to register and will automatically be given access to the guaranteed sale. The guaranteed sale opens at 8.15am on Tuesday November 10.

All Red members with between four and 12 credits can register to enter the ballot. Registration closes at 10am GMT on Monday November 2.

Ballot results will be emailed by Friday 13 November.
